title: 学校であった怖い話S
title_romaji: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi S
sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 1,308,331 characters of prose-like text
Genkan memory search during play: menus in Shift-JIS (story not reached)
Headless replay from power-on into the first story (docs/replay.md): memory read at 42 moments, one choice included
Layout: the same 42 moments read again with the buffer's control cells told apart, each compared with its screenshot
Choices: a second replay through 19 choices of two to five answers; the count read right at all 19, and question, answers and cursor were compared with the screenshot at six
Choices: the cells traced frame by frame through three choices; the count is 0 except from a choice's first answer until one is picked
notes: In memory the script is plain Shift-JIS with CRLF line ends, a full-width yen sign and p at each page end, and a choice's answers as bare strings among its instructions. The stretch being shown is laid out into a buffer of 16-bit cells at 0x80061858 (the Shift-JIS code as a little-endian number, 0x0D0A for a line break, 0x0000 at the end), which the layout reads. u32 at 0x80060D00: 0 while text appears, 2 waiting at a line end, 3 waiting at a page end. Text is vertical, 13 characters to a column. A choice has a layout of its own: the answers are read where they lie in the script.
